name: augur
description: Augur — build/deploy platform composing spaces (design system + prototypes repos) into a static site with an overlay worker.

scripts.deploy: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && GV_IDENTITY_PATH="${GV_IDENTITY_PATH:?set it in .env.deploy — path to your deploy shell's identity.json}" GV_DEPLOY_CONFIG_PATH="${GV_DEPLOY_CONFIG_PATH:?set it in .env.deploy — path to your deploy shell's deploy.config.json}" node build.js && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name "${PAGES_PROJECT:?set it in .env.deploy}" --branch main
scripts.deploy:realtime: set -a && . ./.env.deploy && set +a && npx wrangler deploy realtime/src/index.js -c "${REALTIME_CONFIG:?set it in .env.deploy — path to your deploy shell's realtime.wrangler.toml (see realtime/wrangler.example.toml)}"
